title: Checkout 5xx after upstream TLS certificate expired
symptoms: 503/502 errors on ~30% of requests; logs show 'certificate has expired' on calls to the tax-calculation service; DB and pool metrics normal; no recent deploy.
recent_changes: None in checkout-api; tax-calculation service certificate renewal automation had been changed a week earlier.
root_cause: [confirmed] Expired TLS certificate on the internal tax-calculation service after a renewal job failed.
resolution_steps: 1) Read the TLS error in logs and inspected the certificate expiry date | 2) Ran the certificate renewal manually and reloaded the service | 3) Verified checkout calls to tax-calculation succeeded | 4) Fixed the renewal job and added an expiry alert at 21 days
outcome: Errors cleared within ~15 minutes of the new certificate. No data loss.

title: Search p99 latency from shard rebalancing after node replacement
symptoms: p99 latency 4-6s; no full-GC pauses in JVM logs; cluster shows shard relocation in progress; disk and network IO elevated on several nodes.
recent_changes: A search node was replaced during maintenance earlier that afternoon.
root_cause: [confirmed] Shard relocation after node replacement consumed IO and slowed queries.
resolution_steps: 1) Checked cluster health and relocation status | 2) Throttled relocation bandwidth | 3) Waited for relocation to finish while monitoring latency | 4) Scheduled future node replacements off-peak
outcome: Latency normalized after relocation completed (~50 minutes).
